projects.name: Granbury, TX data center
projects.quote: We believe our state-of-the-art 290 MW nameplate capacity data center in Granbury is one of the largest containerized liquid immersion-cooled sites worldwide.

projects.name: Kearney, NE bitcoin mining site
projects.quote: In January 2024, we acquired two operational bitcoin mining sites totaling 390 MW of nameplate capacity.

projects.name: Garden City, TX bitcoin mining site
projects.quote: In April 2024, we acquired an operational bitcoin mining site with 132 megawatts of operational capacity and 200 MW of nameplate capacity.

projects.name: Hannibal and Hopedale, OH data centers
projects.quote: In November 2024, we acquired two operational data centers with 222 MW of interconnect-approved capacity.

projects.name: Findlay, Ohio greenfield data center
projects.quote: In addition to the acquired data centers, we began developing a 150 MW greenfield operational data center in Findlay, Ohio.

projects.name: Hansford County, TX wind farm
projects.quote: In February 2025, we acquired a wind farm with 240 MW of interconnection capacity and 114 MW of nameplate wind capacity.

projects.name: Micro data center initiative at wellheads in Texas and North Dakota
projects.quote: •We launched a 25 MW micro data center initiative at wellheads in Texas and North Dakota, converting excess flared gas into power for our operations.
